aws-region.description: AWS Region reported for the event.

error-code.description: Error code reported by the AWS service.

event-category.description: CloudTrail event category such as Management, Data or NetworkActivity.

event-id.description: CloudTrail eventID identifying this event record.

event-name.description: API operation or other event name recorded by CloudTrail.

event-source.description: AWS service endpoint that reported the event.

event-type.description: CloudTrail event type such as AwsApiCall, AwsConsoleSignIn or AwsServiceEvent.

original-event-id.description: Original CloudTrail event identifier recorded in an addendum.

outcome.description: Outcome reported by the service or unknown when the record is inconclusive.

principal-account-id.description: AWS account identifier reported for the actor.

principal-arn.description: Amazon Resource Name of the calling principal or session.

principal-id.description: Unique principal identifier as recorded by CloudTrail.

read-only.description: Whether CloudTrail identifies the action as read-only.

recipient-account-id.description: Account to which this CloudTrail event record was delivered.

request-id.description: Identifier assigned to the request by the AWS service.

review-status.description: Analyst review status of the imported observation.

session-issuer-arn.description: ARN of the session issuer reported by CloudTrail.

shared-event-id.description: Identifier shared by separate CloudTrail records of one action delivered to multiple accounts.

source-address.description: Original sourceIPAddress value, which may be an IP, service name or AWS placeholder.

source-ip.description: Validated IP address from CloudTrail sourceIPAddress.

user-agent.description: User agent recorded for the action.

description: One AWS CloudTrail audit event with its operation, event time, observed principal, and reported outcome. Link source logs and related cloud entities with object references.
name: aws-cloudtrail-event
